name: default
purpose: The default options, with a binary proof; BVE runs and eliminates nothing here.

name: text
purpose: The text proof format.

name: no_minimize
purpose: Learned clauses as analysis derives them, unminimized.

name: no_bve_no_vivify
purpose: The proof without BVE or vivification.

name: luby
purpose: A restart every conflict or two changes which reasons a subsumed clause is still named by, and so which replacement and deletion lines are written.

name: cyclic
purpose: The cyclic selector, which gives the propagator no trigger hint and stops short of a fixed point.

name: sparse
purpose: The sparse representation under the exact watchlist.

name: sparse_cyclic
purpose: The sparse representation under the cyclic selector.

name: unused_passes
purpose: Deletion passes close enough together that clauses run out of unused passes and are deleted.

name: vivify_forced_restart
purpose: A vivification pass due above the root forces a restart with replay, which propagates from the narrowed clauses.

name: phase_rotate
purpose: Phase rotation reaches its default-phase step.

name: stabilize
purpose: Stable and focused modes alternate and focused mode restarts.

name: unused_vars
purpose: Half the declared variables are unused, and the proof is over all of them.

name: cnf_xor
purpose: CNF-XOR input numbers its XOR lines among the clauses in file order, which the proof's reasons cite.

name: empty_clause
purpose: An empty input clause ends the run at once, and the proof cites it by its position.

name: empty_clause_cnf_xor
purpose: An empty XOR line in CNF-XOR input ends the run at once, and the proof cites it by its position.

name: wide
purpose: 135 variables, three words a row, so rewrite lines and the renumbering span word boundaries; one-sided BVE gates make equations false at the root.

name: no_compact
purpose: Substitutions not followed by a renumbering, so the variables keep their numbers.

name: vivify
purpose: Vivification narrows clauses at root visits, each narrowing a line derived by the trial's propagation, and deletes the clause it replaces.

name: unused_vars_wide
purpose: Half the declared variables are unused, and the substitutions renumber the rest.

name: subsume_pass
purpose: The subsumption pass: each strengthened clause is a line hinted by the wider clause and the narrower, and a subsumed or strengthened clause is deleted.

name: equivalent_clause_eviction
purpose: A substitution rewrites a clause into another's span: the rewritten one is evicted and its line deleted, and the refutation cites the one kept.

name: equivalent_clause_eviction_subsumption
purpose: A subsumption replacement that a kept clause already is, is never written.

name: bve
purpose: BVE eliminates a variable, and the refutation cites its resolvent.

name: implication_graph
purpose: The implication graph learns a unit, and the refutation needs it.
